latest_messages.headline: Week ending 09-25: -0.65% | SPY +1.28% | alpha -1.92% | grade D+
latest_messages.body: Losing week vs the market, our widest miss in this stretch. We slipped ~$629 (-0.65%) while the S&P 500 jumped +1.28% - a risk-on week our deliberately defensive stocks were built to lag (every one of our 5 stocks drifted down while the market sprinted up; only our S&P cushion kept pace). Zero trades, and that was right: nothing hit a stop, no thesis broke (all 5 re-verified intact), and selling good stocks while they're down to chase a rally that already happened is the classic mistake. D+ = clean process, bad scoreboard. Cumulative we're now ~5 pts behind SPY (a run-worst). I'm setting a 2-strike clock on the defensive stock-picks: strike 1 this week - if they lag again next week or two with nothing broken, I'll bring you a plain A/B decision (keep picking stocks vs. lean on the market-cushion). No quiet changes - your call. Next: PCE inflation report Wed 9/30; watching MDT (thinnest cushion ~2.8%).
